column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3: You came back to Vale.\nDoes it still feel\nlike home, Isaac?{end_wait}
You wear Jenna's face.\nBut I know what\nyou are.{end_wait}
Then stop talking.\nShow me what you\ncan do.{end_wait}
So you can fight.\nDon't mistake that\nfor saving anyone.{end_wait}
These guards tried\nto hold the gate.\nThey couldn't.{end_wait}
They're hurt.\nStep aside. We have\nto reach them.{end_wait}
Still trying to save\neveryone? Then come\nthrough me.{end_wait}
You won this time.\nThe road ahead won't\nbe so kind.{end_wait}
